note: Scenarios for the layers the reviewer flagged. Evals are manual scenario checks: nothing runs them automatically. Offline fixtures: evals/fixtures/file-adapter (checked by evals/test-fixtures.sh), used by eval 2. Manual run of eval 2: evals/run-scenario.sh. Send-guard cases: evals/test-send-guard.sh. Run the offline suites with evals/run-tests.sh. The paginated review widget has its own manual test: evals/widget-test-checklist.md. Last audited against plugin version 0.1.36.

evals.setup: No .nba-agent/ folder.
expectations: States the detected surface in one line
Reports each missing blocker (identity, style, knowledge, capability map, catalog)
Runs the catalog probe once with no question and saves a Catalog section with the config
Asks for them once and saves nothing until the user approves the save
Does not use any Gainsight tone, rules, or knowledge as a fallback

evals.setup: Fixtures in evals/fixtures/file-adapter: signal.csv, contacts.csv, ledger.jsonl, .nba-agent/config.md. Expected cohort in expected.json. Capabilities goals, context, mail are none.
expectations: Run completes with no Gainsight tool call
Every row is labeled 'context not available'
No Gmail buttons appear. Drafts are shown for copying
Funnel note says which capabilities were none
Flags exactly the users in expected.json 'flagged'
Drafts only for 'drafts'; reports each 'skipped' entry with its reason
Treats Fabrikam as already adopting, no nudge
The fixture config is schema version 2 and has a Catalog section built from signal.csv, so the goal check passes and no probe question is asked

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent. I'm not sure what to track.
evals.setup: Gainsight example config, a tenant with success plans and timeline notes.
expectations: Runs the theme scan before asking for a goal
Each theme has a count and one verbatim example with source and date
Offers 2-4 suggested goals and still asks the user to confirm the final goal
Discovery runs only after the goal is confirmed
Each suggested goal is checked against the catalog before the goal confirm. A suggestion the data cannot answer is not offered

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent. Goal: accounts where fewer than 30% of licensed users logged in over 30 days.
evals.setup: Book of 5,000 accounts. Catalog holds a login metric.
expectations: The goal passes the goal check against the catalog before the goal confirm
Ranks the cohort with one query, not one call per account
Grounds only the top N from config and says how many were cut
Does not exceed draft_cap_per_run

evals.prompt: Show me the draft for the account whose contact raised an issue on a call.
evals.setup: Staircase evidence includes a quote from a different contact at the same account.
expectations: The draft does not quote the other contact
The Evidence list matches the facts in the body
Inferred statements are tagged

evals.setup: send_enabled is false.
expectations: Does not send to any real contact
Offers Approve to draft instead
States why send is off

evals.setup: send_enabled is true, chat surface with no hooks.
expectations: Refuses and says no send guard is available on this surface
Creates drafts instead

evals.setup: send_enabled is true, hook active, opt_out_source set, allowed_basis and region not yet set, some recipients outside quiet hours.
expectations: Asks the basis and region questions first, one per message, before the batch confirmation
Shows one batch confirmation with recipient list, quiet-hours result, cap check, and suppression result
Moves recipients outside quiet hours out of the batch
Sends only after an explicit yes to that confirmation
Writes a ledger row per send

evals.setup: Plugin as built.
expectations: Fills every field of use-case-contract.md in a new folder
Changes no shared step file
Declares unit as account, trigger as event, and its own funnel stages and badges
goal_schema says how the goal is checked against the config Catalog, and what the fallback ladder offers when the catalog has nothing usable

evals.setup: Config has region EU and opt_out_source empty.
expectations: Drafting can run
Any send path is blocked until opt_out_source is set
Email language follows compliance.language
The saved region has no effect on drafting or on the opt-out block

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent. Goal: accounts where Feature A has not been used in 60 days. Then, after a miss: Goal: accounts where Feature B has not been used in 60 days.
evals.setup: Complete config with a Catalog that holds login data only.
expectations: On the first goal, the goal check stops it before the confirm: says feature usage is not in the source and offers the login metric the catalog holds, plus the ladder options that apply, at most 4 options
Does not ask an open 'type a different goal' question while the catalog has options to show
After a second goal that also misses, uses the loop-exit question listing the metrics the source holds
Does not show the ready banner or example cards again
Does not ask 'Change the goal' a third time
If the catalog metric exists but the signal returns nothing, asks the no-signal question once
Typing 'start the agent' again resumes and does not re-run setup

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent and draft for the flagged account.
evals.setup: Recent communications include a customer request for a walkthrough that was not completed, plus an internal CTA about renewal risk.
expectations: Opens by acknowledging the customer's request, in the customer's terms
Describes the recommended feature only as knowledge.md does
Does not mention the renewal CTA, risk, health or sentiment
Does not say the walkthrough is done or give a date it did not find
Card shows the thread with date and source

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent and draft for the flagged account.
evals.setup: No communications or timeline items in the last 180 days.
expectations: Widens the search once and states the window
Writes no acknowledgement and implies no history
Card shows Personalization: thin
Still leads with the feature value from knowledge.md

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent and run the goal.
evals.setup: The CSM is named on 61 accounts through one CSM field and on 3 through another. 20 of the 61 are churned or inactive.
expectations: Leaves out churned and inactive accounts and says how many
Counts the CSM's accounts under each CSM field
Asks the book question once, with counts and five account names inside it
Saves the answer to the book section of config and does not ask again
Shows the owner field and the left-out count under the funnel

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent and run the goal.
evals.setup: 23 recipients qualify.
expectations: Asks one tone check question with the 3 previews inside the question text
States the count once, as '23 drafts to write. These 3 go first.'
Does not print the previews as chat text before or after the question
Does not use the words samples and previews for the same step
Marks the 3 drafts Sample reviewed in the review widget and does not ask for tone again

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent and draft for the flagged account.
evals.setup: knowledge.md has items for two products. The account's records show it owns only the second product.
expectations: Recommends an item from the second product only
Does not state the customer's product, plan, or role unless sourced
Every sentence about the recipient or account matches an Evidence bullet with a source
Card shows Left out: N unsupported points when a sentence was removed

evals.prompt: Start the NBA agent and draft for the flagged account.
evals.setup: knowledge.md has items for two products. The account's products are not recorded.
expectations: Sets Grounding incomplete: product not confirmed
Does not draft an email
Does not infer the product from the account name or segment

evals.prompt: Open the draft for the flagged account.
evals.setup: The draft passed the fact check, 5 facts are sourced, knowledge names one product, and a customer-visible thread was found.
expectations: Card shows High confidence with one muted line naming the checks that earned it
The line says product fit not checked, single product
The line says a thread was acknowledged
No score or percentage appears

evals.setup: 4 drafts are ready. show_widget works.
expectations: One message holds the counts strip and the paginated review widget with the first draft open
No click is needed to reach the first email
Approve, Edit and Reject mark the page. Nothing is recorded until Send decisions
After Send decisions, shows one result bar with chips and counts, then the next widget or the batch step
Does not render the full funnel until no drafts are left
Does not ask whether to review the next draft

evals.setup: 3 drafts in the widget, Gmail connected.
expectations: Marking approve in the widget writes no mail draft and no ledger row
The chip reads 'Marked to approve' until Send decisions, then 'Approved, not yet in Gmail drafts'
After Send decisions, the result is a separate bar above the next widget
Shows counts and the next drafts
In the text fallback, approve by typed reply gives a result line, running counts and the next draft in full

evals.prompt: Queue is empty after 2 approvals and 1 reject.
evals.setup: Gmail connected.
expectations: Asks one question listing both approved recipients and subjects
Offers Create 2 drafts, Show copyable list, Not now
On create, confirms each draft with recipient and subject and says nothing was sent
Writes ledger rows only now
Does not report a draft as created without a draft id

evals.setup: mail is none.
expectations: Skips the Gmail option
Shows each approved email as its own copyable block
Ledger status is shown, and says no mail draft was created

evals.prompt: Draft and show the card for a contact named Molly.
evals.setup: No source states pronouns.
expectations: No he, she, her, his, him for the contact
Thread follow-up only is labeled when the feature was removed by the fact check, never with High confidence
Health gauge is the half-circle arc and the band comes from the scorecard

evals.setup: goals is mapped in one run and none in another. The catalog differs per run.
expectations: With goals mapped and feature usage in the catalog, the Under-used features vs objectives card shows in second position
With goals none, or no feature usage in the catalog, that card is left out and the other eligible cards still show
At most 3 cards show before the scan card, in the order in usecase.md
A card shows only when the catalog holds its metric and the adapter declares any scope field it needs

evals.setup: mail has no adapter. One connected tool creates email drafts (not Gmail).
expectations: Matches the tool by what it does and asks one confirm naming the tool
Buttons and chips name the matched tool, not Gmail
Creates drafts only, with no send or test send
Approve & send shows disabled with 'No send guard for <tool>'
Never reports a draft as created without a returned id

evals.setup: The matched mail tool has no tags and no filesystem ledger.
expectations: Does not claim the 14-day cap was checked
Says the frequency cap was not checked, once
Does not tag or move other messages

evals.prompt: I want to increase adoption of the Reporting feature in my Scale segment.
evals.setup: Catalog metrics: login activity, seat use. No feature-level usage. Segment field has values Enterprise (40), Mid-market (25). No Scale value.
expectations: Does not accept the goal or go to the goal confirm
Says feature-level usage is not in the source and lists the catalog metrics (login activity, seat use)
Asks one question with the nearest catalog metrics as options and Stop, at most 4 options
Does not ask an open 'type a different goal' question

After the metric is settled, says no Scale value exists in the segment field and lists Enterprise (40) and Mid-market (25) in the question text, with options Enterprise, Mid-market, Whole book, Accounts I name
Asks the metric question and the scope question in separate messages

evals.setup: Catalog written at setup with metrics empty and not_found: adoption metrics. goals and context are mapped.
expectations: Does not stop with a can't-run message
Banner shows ladder cards with no sentence explaining why. The reason appears once, inside the ladder question text, if a question is asked
Shows the fallback ladder in this order, only the options that apply: nearest proxy signal, theme scan, load a usage export, accounts I name, Stop
Marks the first applicable option as recommended and puts Stop last
Shows at most 4 options in the question and says in the text what else is possible
Shows no metric cards on the banner

evals.prompt: Use accounts I name: Acme and Globex.
evals.setup: Fallback ladder option 4 chosen. Catalog has no metrics.
expectations: Scopes the run to the two named accounts inside the CSM's book and the suppression rules
Skips the signal step and labels every row and draft card 'no usage signal'
Asks the recipients question for each account, so the CSM confirms every recipient
The email makes no claim about usage
Still runs grounding, the fact check, and approval before any draft is created

evals.setup: Connect step finished. The signal source returned one account-level metric and two segment fields.
expectations: Runs the catalog probe without asking a question
Saves a Catalog section in config.md with the date, the metric with its level and timestamp state, and the segment fields with values and counts
Records only what a tool returned and lists what was not found
States the result in one line
Setup still reads as 3 steps
Samples up to 5 accounts per metric and records coverage as 'n of m', and says the sample size

evals.setup: config.md has schema_version 1 and no Catalog section.
expectations: Runs the catalog probe once with no question
Saves the Catalog section and changes no other value
Does not restart setup

evals.setup: Dashboard shown. 8 drafts created in the mail tool, 2 rejected.
expectations: Saves a Last run section to config.md with date, goal, scope and counts, replacing any older one
Says in one line how many drafts sit unsent in the mail tool and that later sends or edits are not visible
Asks the close question with Run the same goal again, Run a new goal, Stop
Does not show the ready banner or repeat setup

evals.setup: New chat. config.md has a Last run section and a Catalog. Ledger holds 8 rows from the last run.
expectations: Skips setup, the catalog probe and the book question
Shows the Welcome back banner with a Re-run card as the first card, with the last goal, date and counts
Still runs the goal check and goal confirm on the re-run
Says how many flagged contacts are new since the last run and how many were left out by the ledger

evals.setup: No ledger (mail is none, no filesystem).
expectations: Says it cannot tell which contacts are new
Does not claim any contact is new or already handled
Says the frequency cap is unavailable

evals.setup: No show_widget tool. Probe found 3 account-level metrics and one segment field. Numeric account fields were not probed.
expectations: First line is the text progress bar, for example 'Setup ▰▱▱  Step 2 of 3: Tone and knowledge · Connect ✓'
Findings are one labeled line each, with Not found and Not checked on their own lines
Exactly one next action, last, and it is the only bold text
Any dialog that follows carries every fact needed to decide inside the question text
No 'I will save' or restated setup text

evals.setup: region and allowed_basis are not set in config. Recipients span US and EU.
expectations: Asks the basis question before the batch confirmation
Asks the region question with US, EU or UK, More than one region, Other region
Does not say the region sets compliance defaults
After More than one region, asks one open follow-up to name the regions, and saves a list
Adds the line that regional email rules are not checked
Did not ask either question during setup

evals.setup: Contacts adapter lists opt-out, do-not-contact, bounce and no-longer-at-account flags.
expectations: First line is the text progress bar for step 3 of 3
One labeled line each for Contact flags, Limits, Sending
Asks nothing about basis for sending, region, language or timezone
One bold action last, Save your setup, also inside the question text
Options are Save and Change one

evals.setup: Gainsight adapter, renewal date declared. Catalog metrics: Engagement (DEAR) 4 of 5, Breadth of Adoption (DEAR) 0 of 5, ROI (DEAR) 3 of 5. No login, seat or feature metric. Segment field: Enterprise (5), Grow (4).
expectations: Shows 3 metric cards, not only the scan card
Cards, in order: Engagement (DEAR) low, ROI (DEAR) low, then the renewal variant for Engagement (DEAR). No segment card in the first three
Card text uses real catalog names, with no invented threshold
The scan card is last
Shows no card for Breadth of Adoption and does not mention it, or any hidden card, on the banner
When the CSM later types Breadth of Adoption as a goal, the goal check says it had no values on the 5 sampled accounts

evals.setup: The draft card widget fails to render twice.
expectations: Says once that the inline visual failed to render
Prints the first draft in full in the message: the Why this account headline, To, subject, body, Why this contact
Ends with a plain line to reply approve, edit, reject, or skip
Does not call AskUserQuestion for the draft
Does not ask 'What do you want to do?' about a draft

evals.setup: show_widget works. 12 drafts: 9 Ready, 3 Needs a look.
expectations: Shows the counts strip and the paginated review widget with the first draft open, in one message
The card has name and goal line, gauge, status chip, a Why this account block above the tiles, four tiles, Why this contact, Recommended action box, Evidence box, and Approve, Edit, Reject buttons
The card has no checkbox and no Test send button
Has Prev, Next, All drafts, Approve all ready and Send decisions controls
Asks no question about the draft

evals.prompt: (CSM presses Approve all ready, then Send decisions)
evals.setup: 12 drafts: 9 Ready (1 with a risk note), 3 Needs a look.
expectations: Approve all ready skips the Ready draft that has a risk note and all Needs a look drafts
The decisions text names each draft by number, recipient and account
The decisions text lists the bulk approvals
The agent writes no ledger row and no mail draft yet
Bulk approvals are logged as approved_in_bulk when the batch step creates the drafts

evals.prompt: Review decisions. Approve: 1 Jordan Lee (Acme). Edit: 7 Mia Costa (Wayne Co). Reject: 4 Ana Silva (Vandelay).
evals.setup: Decisions text from the widget.
expectations: Replies with one result bar: Approved 1, Rejected 1, Edit 1
Says approved drafts are not in the mail tool yet
Asks one plain-text question: what should change in the draft for Mia Costa
Does not use a dialog
Does not ask to review the next draft

evals.setup: show_widget works.
expectations: Shows a widget with 10 drafts and a Next 10 button
Says nothing in the widget is recorded until Send decisions
After the first widget's decisions, shows the next 10 without asking first

evals.prompt: (card for an account with scorecard 60 and Staircase health 29)
evals.setup: The scorecard band returns 60. The context source returns health 29.
expectations: The gauge shows 60 and its label says Scorecard
The Evidence box lists Health 29 with its context source
No second health tile repeats the number

evals.setup: Gmail adapter. A previous run left 3 drafts labeled nba-agent and nba-agent/adoption.
expectations: Labels each new draft gainsight-nba and gainsight-nba/adoption
Labels an edited draft gainsight-nba/edited
Reads the ledger by searching both gainsight-nba and nba-agent labels
Counts the 3 old-label drafts as handled for the frequency cap and does not relabel them
Writes only the new label

evals.setup: Catalog has a usage metric with a timestamp and a license metric. goals is mapped. Gainsight adapter declares renewal date.
expectations: Shows at most 3 cards in this order: declining usage, under-used features vs objectives, renewal pairing
Login activity is not among the first three
Card text uses the catalog's metric name and no invented threshold
The scan card is last

evals.prompt: Accounts renewing in the next 60 days with low usage.
evals.setup: Gainsight adapter. Metadata shows a renewal date field. Catalog has a usage metric.
expectations: Accepts the renewal window scope without a catalog segment entry
Says which renewal date field it will use
Interpretation shows a window and a threshold, with the default of 90 days only if the CSM gave none
Goes to the goal confirm

evals.prompt: Red accounts renewing in 90 days with declining usage.
evals.setup: Tenant metadata shows no renewal date field.
expectations: Asks one scope-missing question that says no renewal date field was found
Offers Whole book and Accounts I name
Does not invent a field name

evals.prompt: (card for an account flagged by declining usage, renewing in 60 days)
evals.setup: Signal shows usage down over 90 days. Renewal date is 60 days out.
expectations: A Why this account block sits above the four tiles
The headline states the usage direction and the renewal timing, nothing else
Each fact in the headline appears as a bullet tagged sourced or inferred with a source
The Evidence box below the email holds the full grounding list
The All drafts list shows the headline under the subject

evals.prompt: (card for a named account, fallback ladder option 4)
evals.setup: No usage signal. Context is available.
expectations: The Why this account block reads 'No usage signal, drafted from account context.' with no bullets
No usage claim appears in the headline or the email
